title: Abdul Ahmad v. State of U.P. and 4 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi, JJ.
disposition: Disposed; fresh Supply Code order after hearing once recovery withdrawn
headnote: On the Electricity Department's statement that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after hearing the petitioner, the writ was disposed of with liberty to the respondents to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Abdul Ahmad filed Writ-C No. 4991 of 2023 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and four others, seeking quashing of the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division, Khalilabad's order dated 25.06.20222 and a recovery certificate dated 11.01.2023 in an alleged electricity-theft case. On 14 February 2023 the petition was passed over so counsel for respondent nos. 2 to 4 could take instructions, and was directed to be listed as fresh on 21 February 2023.

holding_units.topic: fresh order after withdrawal of electricity-theft recovery
holding_units.holding: Where the Electricity Department states that the impugned recovery in a theft case has been withdrawn and that a fresh order will be passed after hearing the consumer, the writ is disposed of with liberty to the respondents to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: No clause number is cited. 'procedure' records the order's reference to the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and is not a numbered Code clause.

principle_tags.application: The writ ended on the department's concession that the theft recovery stood withdrawn, leaving a fresh order to be passed after hearing and strictly under the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No Code clause was construed.

not_decided.point: Legality of the Executive Engineer's order and the recovery certificate in the electricity-theft case
not_decided.note: The department withdrew the recovery and undertook a fresh order after hearing. The Court did not decide the theft allegation or apply any numbered Supply Code clause.
